definitions.text_mt: Franella: drapp artab ta' suf jew qoton, użat ħafna għall-ħwejjeġ.

usage_examples.mt: Lbist qmis tal-franella biex inżomm sħun.
usage_examples.en: I wore a flannel shirt to keep warm.

usage_examples.mt: Din il-franella hija ratba ħafna u komda.
usage_examples.en: This flannel is very soft and comfortable.

definitions.text_mt: Frankament: b'mod onest u dirett, mingħajr tlagħliq.

usage_examples.mt: Frankament, ma naqbilx mal-fehma tiegħek.
usage_examples.en: Frankly, I do not agree with your view.

usage_examples.mt: Tkellimt miegħu frankament dwar is-sitwazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: I spoke with him frankly about the situation.

definitions.text_mt: Frankiġja: eżenzjoni minn ħlas ta' taxxa jew dazju.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kumpanija ngħatat frankiġja mid-dwana.
usage_examples.en: The company was granted a customs exemption.

usage_examples.mt: Din il-frankiġja tapplika biss għall-merkanzija importata.
usage_examples.en: This exemption applies only to imported goods.

definitions.text_en: France (a country located primarily in Western Europe)
definitions.text_mt: Franza: pajjiż fil-Punent tal-Ewropa, magħruf għall-kultura u l-istorja tiegħu.

usage_examples.mt: Mort Franza s-sajf li għadda.
usage_examples.en: I went to France last summer.

usage_examples.mt: Franza hija magħrufa għall-ikel u l-inbid tagħha.
usage_examples.en: France is known for its food and wine.

definitions.text_mt: Franċiż: li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Franza, mal-poplu jew mal-lingwa tagħha.

usage_examples.mt: Inħobb l-ikel Franċiż, speċjalment il-ġobon.
usage_examples.en: I love French food, especially the cheese.

usage_examples.mt: Hi tgħallem il-lingwa Franċiża fl-iskola.
usage_examples.en: She teaches the French language at school.

definitions.text_mt: Franċiż: raġel li huwa ċittadin ta' Franza.
Franċiż: il-lingwa Rumana mitkellma fi Franza u f'pajjiżi oħra.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa Franċiż imma jgħix Malta minn tletin sena.
usage_examples.en: He is a Frenchman but has lived in Malta for thirty years.

usage_examples.mt: Tgħallimt il-Franċiż meta kont student.
usage_examples.en: I learned French when I was a student.

definitions.text_mt: Franċiża: li għandha x'taqsam ma' Franza, mal-poplu jew mal-lingwa tagħha.

usage_examples.mt: Ixtrajt karozza Franċiża ġdida.
usage_examples.en: I bought a new French car.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kċina Franċiża hija magħrufa mad-dinja kollha.
usage_examples.en: French cuisine is known throughout the world.

definitions.text_mt: Franċiża: mara li hija ċittadina ta' Franza.

usage_examples.mt: Hi Franċiża li twieldet f'Lyon.
usage_examples.en: She is a Frenchwoman born in Lyon.

usage_examples.mt: Il-Franċiża li ltqajna magħha kienet simpatika ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The Frenchwoman we met was very kind.

definitions.text_mt: Franċju: element kimiku radjuattiv, l-aktar wieħed tqil fost il-metalli alkalini.

usage_examples.mt: Il-franċju huwa element radjuattiv skopert fl-1939.
usage_examples.en: Francium is a radioactive element discovered in 1939.

usage_examples.mt: Il-franċju jinsab f'ammonti żgħar ħafna fil-qoxra tal-art.
usage_examples.en: Francium is found in very small amounts in the Earth's crust.

definitions.text_mt: Frar: it-tieni xahar tas-sena, b'28 jew 29 jum.

usage_examples.mt: Frar huwa l-iqsar xahar tas-sena.
usage_examples.en: February is the shortest month of the year.

usage_examples.mt: Il-festa tinżamm fl-aħħar ġimgħa ta' Frar.
usage_examples.en: The feast is held in the last week of February.

definitions.text_mt: Fras-servjent: għasfur tal-familja tar-Rekurvistrostiti, b'riġlejn roża twal u ġwienaħ bojod u suwed.

usage_examples.mt: Rajt fras-servjent f'nofs il-bassasa.
usage_examples.en: I saw a black-winged stilt in the middle of the marsh.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fras-servjent jinstab ħdejn l-ilma u l-għadajjar.
usage_examples.en: The black-winged stilt is found near water and ponds.

definitions.text_en: brother (member of a religious community or church)
definitions.text_mt: Fratell: raġel li huwa membru ta' komunità reliġjuża.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fratell qatta' ħamsin sena fil-monasteru.
usage_examples.en: The brother spent fifty years in the monastery.

usage_examples.mt: Fratell Ġwanni jgħallem l-iskola tal-knisja.
usage_examples.en: Brother John teaches at the church school.

definitions.text_en: brotherhood (an association of any purpose, a fraternity)
definitions.text_mt: Fratellanza: għaqda jew soċjetà ta' persuni bl-istess interessi jew skop.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fratellanza ngħatat donazzjoni kbira mill-gvern.
usage_examples.en: The brotherhood received a large donation from the government.

usage_examples.mt: Dik il-fratellanza tgħin lill-foqra u lill-batuti.
usage_examples.en: That brotherhood helps the poor and the needy.

definitions.text_mt: Fratiċell: patri żgħir, speċjalment wieħed li għadu fil-bidu tal-ħajja reliġjuża.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fratiċell kien qed jistudja biex isir patri.
usage_examples.en: The young friar was studying to become a monk.

usage_examples.mt: Fratiċell tawduru fil-ġnien tal-monasteru.
usage_examples.en: A young friar was walking around the monastery garden.

definitions.text_mt: Fratriċida: persuna li toqtol lil ħuha.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fratriċida nstab ħati u ngħata l-ħabs għal għomorru.
usage_examples.en: The fratricide was found guilty and sentenced to life imprisonment.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa kkunsidrat fratriċida talli qatel lil ħuh.
usage_examples.en: He was considered a fratricide for killing his brother.

definitions.text_mt: Fratriċidju: qtil ta' ħu wieħed.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fratriċidju huwa reat serju fil-biċċa l-kbira tal-kulturi.
usage_examples.en: Fratricide is a serious crime in most cultures.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-rumanz jitkellem dwar fratriċidju f'familja nobbli.
usage_examples.en: The novel speaks of a fratricide in a noble family.

definitions.text_mt: Frawdità: qagħda ta' tfixkil jew diffikultà, speċjalment minħabba qerq jew frodi.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frawdità tal-kumpanija ġabet telf kbir lill-azzjonisti.
usage_examples.en: The company's fraudulent dealings caused great loss to the shareholders.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm ħafna frawdità wara l-falliment tal-bank.
usage_examples.en: There was much trouble after the bank's bankruptcy.

definitions.text_mt: Frawdulent: li mhux onest; li sar bil-qerq jew bl-ingann.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kuntratt kien frawdulent u għalhekk ma kellux effett.
usage_examples.en: The contract was fraudulent and therefore had no effect.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bejjiegħ kien qed juża prattiċi frawdulenti biex iqarraq bil-klijenti.
usage_examples.en: The seller was using fraudulent practices to deceive customers.

definitions.text_mt: Frawla: frotta ħamra żgħira, ħelwa u mmerqa, li tikber mal-art.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frawli f'dan l-istaġun huma ħelwin ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The strawberries this season are very sweet.

usage_examples.mt: Kilt tazza mimlija frawli bil-krema.
usage_examples.en: I ate a cup full of strawberries with cream.

definitions.text_mt: Fraxxnu: siġra tal-ġeneru Fraxinus, b'injam iebes u weraq bil-pinnati.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fraxxnu jikber sew fl-art niedja u fil-widien.
usage_examples.en: The ash tree grows well in damp soil and valleys.

usage_examples.mt: L-injam tal-fraxxnu jintuża għall-għamara u għall-manfattura.
usage_examples.en: Ash wood is used for furniture and manufacturing.

definitions.text_mt: Frażarju: ktieb jew lista ta' frażijiet u espressjonijiet ta' lingwa partikolari.

usage_examples.mt: Ixtri frażarju qabel tmur l-Italja biex tifhem lill-poplu.
usage_examples.en: Buy a phrasebook before going to Italy to understand the locals.

usage_examples.mt: Dan il-frażarju fih eluf ta' frażijiet utli għall-vjaġġaturi.
usage_examples.en: This phrasebook contains thousands of useful phrases for travellers.

definitions.text_mt: Frażi: sekwenza ta' kliem li tesprimi ħsieb sħiħ, magħmula minn suġġett u predikat.
Frażi: grupp ta' kliem li jiffurmaw unità grammatikali mingħajr ma jkunu sentenza sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: Din il-frażi mhix kompluta għax m'għandhiex verb.
usage_examples.en: This sentence is not complete because it does not have a verb.

usage_examples.mt: Uża frażi qasira biex tispjega l-idea prinċipali.
usage_examples.en: Use a short phrase to explain the main idea.

definitions.text_mt: Frażjoloġija: sett ta' frażijiet u espressjonijiet karatteristiċi ta' lingwa jew dixxiplina; l-istudju tagħhom.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frażjoloġija tiegħu turi l-livell għoli tal-edukazzjoni li rċieva.
usage_examples.en: His phraseology shows the high level of education he received.

usage_examples.mt: Qed nistudja l-frażjoloġija Maltija għar-riċerka tiegħi.
usage_examples.en: I am studying Maltese phraseology for my research.

definitions.text_mt: Frejgħen: fergħun żgħir; persuna ħażina żgħira; xitan żgħir.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-rakkont jitkellem dwar frejgħen li kien jgħix fil-gżira.
usage_examples.en: The story speaks of a little devil who lived on the island.

definitions.text_mt: Frejwel: firjol żgħir; kappa żgħira.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frejwel kien imżejjen bil-ħarir u l-perli.
usage_examples.en: The small cape was decorated with silk and pearls.

usage_examples.mt: Libset frejwel tad-deheb ma' għonqha għaċ-ċerimonja.
usage_examples.en: She wore a small gold capelet around her neck for the ceremony.
